We genuinely appreciate hearing from our patients, as it helps us to continually improve our service.

I am very sorry to hear that your experience with our reception team did not meet your expectations. We take professionalism and all patient-facing interactions extremely seriously, and your comments will be reviewed so that we can address this appropriately.

With regard to e-consultations, I would like to take the opportunity to explain their purpose and how they support patient care. E-consultations have been very well received by the majority of our patients and are often the most effective way to contact the practice. Submitted forms are reviewed and triaged by a clinician within our triage hub, usually within the hour, allowing patients direct access to the clinical team for questions, concerns, or administrative requests.

We encourage patients who are able to use e-consultations to do so, as this helps our reception team remain available for those who need face-to-face or telephone support and are unable to use digital services. This approach allows us to provide better access and support for all our patients.

Thank you again for your feedback and for bringing your concerns to our However, since its implementation, our feedback in the national GP practice survey has increased dramatically, with the majority of our patients finding that access has improved following its introduction.
